user_intent: Bootstrap a password-protected Astro portfolio site from a Figma design system, then iteratively design ~15 interactive hero-background variants (physics shapes, drawn collages, eye-tracking monsters, video shaders, sounds) and ship them as a random per-visit rotation.
resolution: Each hero variant became an isolated React island (src/components/auth/*) driven by SVG shape sets pulled straight from Figma frames via the Figma MCP (get_design_context + download_assets, 51 asset downloads across the chat) and converted into shape-data modules like collageShapes.ts and physicsShapesC.ts. Side-by-side /compare-* routes were used to iterate per-variant, then retired in favor of a random rotation (HeroRotator + variantBag) with a shared text position, grain/noise overlay tuned to 18-22% opacity, and cross-variant fade transitions. The password gate was styled from Figma tokens with Cuelume typing/hover sound effects, gated by browser autoplay policy (sound only after first user gesture).
